title: TestSuiteBench: Coding Agents Struggle to Generate Strong Test Suites from Specifications
abstract: arXiv:2610.13065v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly used to create large software projects. While code-generation benchmarks have scaled accordingly to full applications, test-generation benchmarks remain limited to individual functions or bug fixes. In particular, generating complete test suites for complex software from scratch remains unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce TestSuiteBench, a benchmark of 165 open-source applications, each with a structured and detailed specification of intended behavior, a reference implementation, a reference test suite, and on average 74 mutants. Each mutant is generated from a single requirement of the specification and refined to isolate that behavior: 73\% are killed by exactly one reference test and, on average, by only 0.2\% of the remaining tests. translated_title: TestSuiteBench：编程智能体难以根据规范生成强测试套件
translated_abstract: 编程智能体越来越多地被用于创建大型软件项目。虽然代码生成基准已相应扩展到完整应用程序层面，但测试生成基准仍然局限于单个函数或错误修复。尤其是，从零开始为复杂软件生成完整测试套件仍然是一个未被探索的领域。为填补这一空白，我们提出了TestSuiteBench，这是一个包含165个开源应用程序的基准，每个应用程序都配有结构化且详细的预期行为规范、参考实现、参考测试套件，以及平均74个变异体。每个变异体均从规范中的单个需求生成，并经过精炼以隔离该行为：73%的变异体恰好被一个参考测试所杀死，平均仅被其余测试中的0.2%杀死。我们发现，即使是前沿的编程智能体，在给定我们的规范时也难以生成强测试套件，其变异分数低于60%，尽管它们的测试套件（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了包含165个开源应用程序及详细行为规范的TestSuiteBench基准，并通过实验揭示即使是前沿编程智能体也难以根据规范生成强测试套件，其变异分数低于60%。
en_tdlr: TestSuiteBench, a benchmark of 165 open-source applications with detailed specifications and mutants, reveals that even frontier coding agents struggle to generate strong test suites from specifications, achieving mutation scores below 60%.
